speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal — restart the agent in the cell you are looking at
description: Short feature clip. Changing an MCP server or the config leaves a running agent with the old view of the world; an opt-in header button restarts it in place — same cell, same directory. Slides are English in both language versions.

beats.text: Changed an MCP server, a plugin, or your config? One button restarts the agent in place — no trip back through the launcher.
